statBlock.name: Adult Black Dragon
statBlock.description: This cruel swamp dragon spreads choking fog and spoils the water around its lair.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The dragon breathes both air and water.
Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). When the dragon fails a save, it can spend a use to succeed instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. One can be replaced by using Spellcasting for level 3 Melf's Acid Arrow.
Rend. Melee attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage.
Acid Breath (recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 60-ft. line, 5 ft. wide, makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. Failure deals 54 (12d8) Acid damage. Success halves the damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Casting one of these spells uses an action and requires no Material components. Charisma is the spellcasting ability. Spell save DC 17, spell attacks +9.
At will. Detect Magic, Fear, Melf's Acid Arrow (level 3).
1/day each. Speak with Dead, Vitriolic Sphere.
sections.Legendary actions:
The dragon has 3 legendary action uses, or 4 in its lair. Immediately after another creature's turn, it can spend one use to take one option below. It regains spent uses at the start of its turn.
Cloud of Insects. One visible creature within 120 ft. makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 22 (4d10) Poison damage and has Disadvantage on saves to maintain Concentration through the end of its next turn. The dragon can use this option again starting on its next turn.
Frightful Presence. Use Spellcasting to cast Fear. The dragon can use this option again starting on its next turn.
Pounce. The dragon can move up to half its Speed and makes one Rend attack.
sections.Lair resources: In the lair, this encounter is worth 13,000 XP. The dragon has 4 daily Legendary Resistance uses and 4 legendary action uses.
sections.Regional effects:
Acrid Haze. Thick, foul fog leaves the area within 1 mile Lightly Obscured. Travel there takes twice as long for creatures other than the dragon and its allies.
Foul Water. Water sources within 1 mile are magically polluted. A creature drinking from one makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is Poisoned for 1 hour.
Both effects end immediately if the dragon dies or moves its lair elsewhere.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), pp. 39 and 40 for the stat block and regional effects.

statBlock.name: Adult Blue Dragon
statBlock.description: This desert and coastal dragon surrounds its lair with storms and unstable ground.

sections.Traits: Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). When the dragon fails a save, it can spend a use to succeed instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. One can be replaced by using Spellcasting for Shatter.
Rend. Melee attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit 16 (2d8 + 7) Slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) Lightning damage.
Lightning Breath (recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 90-ft. line, 5 ft. wide, makes a DC 19 Dexterity save. Failure deals 60 (11d10) Lightning damage. Success halves the damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Casting one of these spells uses an action and requires no Material components. Charisma is the spellcasting ability. Spell save DC 18.
At will. Detect Magic, Invisibility, Mage Hand, Shatter.
1/day each. Scrying, Sending.
sections.Legendary actions:
The dragon has 3 legendary action uses, or 4 in its lair. Immediately after another creature's turn, it can spend one use to take one option below. It regains spent uses at the start of its turn.
Cloaked Flight. Use Spellcasting to cast Invisibility on the dragon itself. It can then fly up to half its Fly Speed. The dragon can use this option again starting on its next turn.
Sonic Boom. Use Spellcasting to cast Shatter. The dragon can use this option again starting on its next turn.
Tail Swipe. Make one Rend attack.
sections.Lair resources: In the lair, this encounter is worth 18,000 XP. The dragon has 4 daily Legendary Resistance uses and 4 legendary action uses.
sections.Regional effects:
Sinkholes. When a creature other than the dragon or an ally finishes a Long Rest within 1 mile of the lair, roll 1d20. On a 1, the ground opens beneath it. A failed DC 15 Dexterity save drops it 2d4 × 10 ft. into the sinkhole.
Spiteful Storms. Thunderstorms and dust devils leave the area within 1 mile Lightly Obscured.
Both effects end immediately if the dragon dies or moves its lair elsewhere.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), pp. 49 and 50 for the stat block and regional effects.

statBlock.name: Adult Green Dragon
statBlock.description: This forest dragon uses magic to spy through nearby animals and turn its chosen hunting ground toxic.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The dragon breathes both air and water.
Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). When the dragon fails a save, it can spend a use to succeed instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. One can be replaced by using Spellcasting for level 3 Mind Spike.
Rend. Melee attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit 15 (2d8 + 6) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.
Poison Breath (recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 18 Constitution save. Failure deals 56 (16d6) Poison damage. Success halves the damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Casting one of these spells uses an action and requires no Material components. Charisma is the spellcasting ability. Spell save DC 17.
At will. Detect Magic, Mind Spike (level 3).
1/day. Geas.
sections.Legendary actions:
The dragon has 3 legendary action uses, or 4 in its lair. Immediately after another creature's turn, it can spend one use to take one option below. It regains spent uses at the start of its turn.
Mind Invasion. Use Spellcasting to cast Mind Spike at level 3.
Noxious Miasma. Center a 20-ft.-radius sphere on a visible point within 90 ft. Each creature in the sphere makes a DC 17 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 7 (2d6) Poison damage and a −2 AC penalty until the end of its next turn. The dragon can use this option again starting on its next turn.
Pounce. The dragon can move up to half its Speed and makes one Rend attack.
sections.Lair resources: In the lair, this encounter is worth 15,000 XP. The dragon has 4 daily Legendary Resistance uses and 4 legendary action uses.
sections.Regional effects:
Beast Spies. Within 1 mile of the lair, Tiny Beasts magically understand Draconic and can speak telepathically with the dragon.
Poisonous Thicket. Plants contaminate the air within 1 mile. A creature other than the dragon or an ally that finishes a Long Rest there makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is Poisoned for 1 hour.
Both effects end immediately if the dragon dies or moves its lair elsewhere.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), pp. 153 and 154 for the stat block and regional effects.

statBlock.name: Adult Red Dragon
statBlock.description: This mountain or hill dragon turns nearby lands hot and fills the air with ash.

sections.Traits: Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). When the dragon fails a save, it can spend a use to succeed instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. One can be replaced by using Spellcasting for Scorching Ray.
Rend. Melee attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit 13 (1d10 + 8) Slashing damage plus 5 (2d4) Fire damage.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 21 Dexterity save. Failure deals 59 (17d6) Fire damage. Success halves the damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Casting one of these spells uses an action and requires no Material components. Charisma is the spellcasting ability. Spell save DC 20, spell attacks +12.
At will. Command (level 2), Detect Magic, Scorching Ray.
1/day. Fireball.
sections.Legendary actions:
The dragon has 3 legendary action uses, or 4 in its lair. Immediately after another creature's turn, it can spend one use to take one option below. It regains spent uses at the start of its turn.
Commanding Presence. Use Spellcasting to cast Command at level 2. The dragon can use this option again starting on its next turn.
Fiery Rays. Use Spellcasting to cast Scorching Ray. The dragon can use this option again starting on its next turn.
Pounce. The dragon can move up to half its Speed and makes one Rend attack.
sections.Lair resources: In the lair, this encounter is worth 20,000 XP. The dragon has 4 daily Legendary Resistance uses and 4 legendary action uses.
sections.Regional effects:
Burning Heat. Extreme heat extends 1 mile from the lair. In the area, a burning creature or object takes 1d4 extra Fire damage at the start of each of its turns.
Smoldering Haze. Airborne ash leaves the region within 1 mile Lightly Obscured. A creature other than the dragon or an ally that finishes a Long Rest in the area makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is Poisoned for 1 hour.
Both effects end immediately if the dragon dies or moves its lair elsewhere.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), pp. 255 and 256 for the stat block and regional effects.

statBlock.name: Adult White Dragon
statBlock.speed: 40 ft., burrow 30 ft., fly 80 ft., swim 40 ft.
statBlock.description: This arctic dragon climbs on ice and hunts through freezing fog.

sections.Traits:
Ice Walk. The dragon crosses or climbs ice without an ability check. Difficult Terrain made of snow or ice costs it no extra movement.
Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). When the dragon fails a save, it can spend a use to succeed instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Cold damage.
Cold Breath (recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 19 Constitution save. Failure deals 54 (12d8) Cold damage. Success halves the damage.
sections.Legendary actions:
The dragon has 3 legendary action uses, or 4 in its lair. Immediately after another creature's turn, it can spend one use to take one option below. It regains spent uses at the start of its turn.
Freezing Burst. Center a 30-ft.-radius sphere on a visible point within 120 ft. Each creature in the sphere makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 7 (2d6) Cold damage and its Speed is 0 until the end of its next turn. The dragon can use this option again starting on its next turn.
Frightful Presence. The dragon casts Fear without Material components, using Charisma with spell save DC 14. The dragon can use this option again starting on its next turn.
Pounce. The dragon can move up to half its Speed and makes one Rend attack.
sections.Lair resources: In the lair, this encounter is worth 11,500 XP. The dragon has 4 daily Legendary Resistance uses and 4 legendary action uses.
sections.Regional effects:
Frigid Cold. Extreme cold extends 1 mile from the lair, and all water there is frigid water. Use the 2024 Dungeon Master's Guide rules for those hazards.
Glacial Gloom. Cold fog leaves the region within 1 mile Lightly Obscured. Any creature other than the dragon or an ally that finishes a Long Rest in the area makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, its Speed drops by 10 ft. for 1 hour.
Both effects end immediately if the dragon dies or moves its lair elsewhere.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), pp. 329 and 330 for the stat block and regional effects.

statBlock.name: Adult Gold Dragon
statBlock.description: This dragon tempers intruders with weakening magic, warns visitors through its lair fog, and can visit their dreams.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The dragon breathes both air and water.
Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). When the dragon fails a save, it can spend a use to succeed instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. One can be replaced by Weakening Breath or by using Spellcasting for level 2 Guiding Bolt.
Rend. Melee attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit 17 (2d8 + 8) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Fire damage.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 21 Dexterity save. Failure deals 66 (12d10) Fire damage. Success halves the damage.
Weakening Breath. Each creature in a 60-ft. cone that is not already affected makes a DC 21 Strength save. Failure gives it Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and reduces its damage rolls by 3 (1d6). It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. The save succeeds automatically after 1 minute.
sections.Spellcasting:
Casting one of these spells uses an action and requires no Material components. Charisma is the spellcasting ability. Spell save DC 21, spell attacks +13.
At will. Detect Magic, Guiding Bolt (level 2), Shapechange. Shapechange is limited to Beast or Humanoid forms. The dragon gains no Temporary Hit Points from it and needs neither Concentration nor Temporary Hit Points to maintain it.
1/day each. Flame Strike, Zone of Truth.
sections.Legendary actions:
The dragon has 3 legendary action uses, or 4 in its lair. Immediately after another creature's turn, it can spend one use to take one option below. It regains spent uses at the start of its turn.
Banish. One visible creature within 120 ft. makes a DC 21 Charisma save. On a failure, it takes 10 (3d6) Force damage and is Incapacitated in a harmless demiplane until the start of the dragon's next turn. It returns in an unoccupied space of the dragon's choice within 120 ft. of the dragon. The dragon can use this option again starting on its next turn.
Guiding Light. Use Spellcasting to cast Guiding Bolt at level 2.
Pounce. The dragon can move up to half its Speed and makes one Rend attack.
sections.Lair resources: In the lair, this encounter is worth 20,000 XP. The dragon has 4 daily Legendary Resistance uses and 4 legendary action uses.
sections.Regional effects:
Dream Messenger. From its lair, the dragon can cast Dream using Charisma and no Material components. It can target any creature within 6 miles.
Foretelling Fog. Opalescent fog leaves the area within 1 mile Lightly Obscured. The fog foreshadows danger, so creatures there cannot be surprised.
Both effects end immediately if the dragon dies or moves its lair elsewhere.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), pp. 145 and 146 for the stat block and regional effects.

statBlock.name: Adult Silver Dragon
statBlock.description: This dragon favors mountains and cities. Near its lair, winds slow falls and it can change the weather.

sections.Traits: Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). When the dragon fails a save, it can spend a use to succeed instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. One can be replaced by Paralyzing Breath or by using Spellcasting for Ice Knife.
Rend. Melee attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit 17 (2d8 + 8) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Cold damage.
Cold Breath (recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 20 Constitution save. Failure deals 54 (12d8) Cold damage. Success halves the damage.
Paralyzing Breath. Every creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 20 Constitution save. On the first failure, it is Incapacitated until the end of its next turn and repeats the save then. On a second failure, it is Paralyzed. A Paralyzed target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. The save succeeds automatically after 1 minute.
sections.Spellcasting:
Casting one of these spells uses an action and requires no Material components. Charisma is the spellcasting ability. Spell save DC 19, spell attacks +11.
At will. Detect Magic, Hold Monster, Ice Knife, Shapechange. Shapechange is limited to Beast or Humanoid forms. The dragon gains no Temporary Hit Points from it and needs neither Concentration nor Temporary Hit Points to maintain it.
1/day each. Ice Storm (level 5), Zone of Truth.
sections.Legendary actions:
The dragon has 3 legendary action uses, or 4 in its lair. Immediately after another creature's turn, it can spend one use to take one option below. It regains spent uses at the start of its turn.
Chill. Use Spellcasting to cast Hold Monster. The dragon can use this option again starting on its next turn.
Cold Gale. Each creature in a 60-ft. line, 10 ft. wide, makes a DC 19 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 14 (4d6) Cold damage and is pushed up to 30 ft. straight away from the dragon. On a success, it takes half damage only. The dragon can use this option again starting on its next turn.
Pounce. The dragon can move up to half its Speed and makes one Rend attack.
sections.Lair resources: In the lair, this encounter is worth 18,000 XP. The dragon has 4 daily Legendary Resistance uses and 4 legendary action uses.
sections.Regional effects:
Gentle Gusts. A creature falling within 1 mile of the lair descends at 60 ft. per round and takes no falling damage.
Sun and Storms. From its lair, the dragon can cast Control Weather using Charisma and no Material components.
Both effects end immediately if the dragon dies or moves its lair elsewhere.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), pp. 279 and 280 for the stat block and regional effects.
